# Wiktionary

> > A comprehensive multilingual dictionary providing word definitions, etymologies, pronunciations (IPA), and grammatical forms across languages including English, Latin, and Japanese.

Wiktionary is a collaborative free dictionary project covering word entries with detailed linguistic information including declensions, conjugations, pronunciation guides in International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA), and distinctions between language variants like Classical Latin vs. Ecclesiastical Latin, and General American vs. Received Pronunciation for English.

## Key Topics

- International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA)
- Classical Latin
- Ecclesiastical Latin
- General American English
- Received Pronunciation
- Latin declension and conjugation
- Verb forms and conjugations
- Adjective and noun inflections
- Past tense and past participle
- Genitive singular forms
- Rōmaji romanization
- Etymology and word origins
- Pronunciation guides
- Grammatical forms

## English Word Forms

- [started - Wiktionary, the free dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/started): English verb form: past tense/participle with pronunciation variants
- [stigmatophilia - Wiktionary, the free dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/stigmatophilia): English noun: paraphilia related to body modification with etymology

## Latin Grammar and Inflections

- [pluribus - Wiktionary, the free dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/pluribus): Latin adjective form with Classical & Ecclesiastical pronunciation guides
- [cruris - Wiktionary, the free dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cruris): Latin noun form: genitive singular declension entry
- [debere - Wiktionary, the free dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/debere): Latin verb conjugation and inflection reference entry

## Japanese and Romanization

- [shizuka - Wiktionary, the free dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/shizuka): Japanese Rōmaji romanization transcription entry
